long_biography.plain_text:
Motor dealer René van Oosten and his business partner changed De Beer's focus from Fiat to Kia as the brands' sales moved in opposite directions. Rather than relying entirely on internet sales, they invested in a showroom intended to feel like a living room. Keeping different models, colours and versions available gave customers a reason to visit in person.

Van Oosten pays close attention to the premises themselves, treating order and cleanliness as part of how a dealership presents its cars. He has used a specialist cleaning contractor over many years, valuing flexible responses when the business needs them.
